name: smjob filter help
purpose: Print the same job-tracker filter help through its registered alias.
side_effects_assessment: Alias uses the same print-only handler as sm_dispatch_job filter help; no filter state is changed. Normal output buffering/interpreter bookkeeping occurs.

help_strings.text:
This udw command enables filtering the output of the job tracker for specified SUID(s).

usage: sm_dispatch_job filter [action] SUID

Available actions:
  1) disable -> Allow job tracking output for the specified SUID
  2) enable  -> Suppress job tracking output for the specified SUID
  3) except  -> Suppress job tracking output for all but the specifed SUID
  4) only    -> Allow job tracking output for only the specified SUID
  5) show    -> Display filtering status for the specified SUID
                If called without a SUID, displays filtering status for all
